texts.en:
Habitable £planet£ Planets sometimes have £blocker£ Blockers, preventing their full exploitation. Clearing a Blocker takes time and costs £energy£ Energy Credits, but can unlock Planetary Features currently blocked as well as free up additional construction space.

To clear a Blocker;

£dot_green£ Select a planet in the Outliner
£dot_green£ Click the Management tab
£dot_green£ Click the Clear Blocker button on the blocker itself


                        £clear_blocker£


In addition to resources, some Blockers require specific Technologies to remove.
